title.en: Quadratic Gauss sums and a 25-billion certificate
title.zh: 二次高斯和与二百五十亿验证

description.en: Evaluate the prime-modulus quadratic Gauss norm, exhibit the obstruction to a uniform conductor cutoff in the exceptional budget, and certify finite prime-log positivity.
description.zh: 计算素数模二次高斯和的范数，展示例外误差预算中统一导子阈值的障碍，并以有限证书验证素数对数卷积的正性。
